title: Global augmented extended Cech model
statement: For a small site (C,J), a sheaf of commutative rings O, a finite type ideal module I with monomorphism ι into O, and the required derived-category instances, there exist a complex K of O-module sheaves and an augmentation ε : K ⟶ O[0] having HasLocalExtendedCechDescription O I ι K ε.

proof.text: Use the concrete Godement ring family with its existing strictly functorial maps. The family of all specified finite ideal-generating slices is covering. The finite-generator descent theorem gives strict augmented complex gluing data.
Effective augmented complex gluing constructs K→O[0] and augmentation-compatible chain isomorphisms from its restriction to each specified slice model.

For every generating list compose its derived Cech comparison with the inverse local gluing isomorphism and the comparison for derived restriction. Naturality of the latter and the augmentation squares give the defining local-description equation. No full-subsite equivalence is used.

proof_origin.place: Tag 099E: all-generating-slices cover, explicit ring-family sheafification and augmented complex gluing; derived augmentation naturality. Tag 099F is supplied by the existing reflector theorem.
